decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for retail unit/ restaurant purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times Monday to Saturday 9.00am to 11.30pm and Sunday 9.00am to 10.30pm.
Condition : 5 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 8am to 6pm nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.
Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted shall be confined to sales to customers attending the premises, and shall not extend to the delivery of food or drink to customers by vehicle.

Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 8 - The use hereby permitted for retail/restaurant purposes shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 9 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 10 - Before development commences details of facilities for the loading, unloading and turning of vehicles clear of the public highway shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and implemented.

Condition : 11 - Before the development commences details of parking (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the spaces shown on the approved drawing shall be available for use before first occupation of any part of the development.

Condition : 12 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced details of the proposed shop front, including a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the retail unit/restaurant, shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 13 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced details of appropriate staff and customer toilet facilities (including disabled toilet facilities) shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.
description: Change of use of ground floor from office to mixed A1/A3 use.
